subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Revises numbers 1 to 4; matches numerals, number words and dot patterns

show.line: Let's count our friends! One, two, three, four. Four friends playing together.

rounds.prompt: How many friends are on the swing?
Which card shows three dots? Count them.
How many kites? Say the number.
One, two, three. What comes next?
Match the dots to the number. Put each card in its number group.

hints: Touch each one as you count.
Four comes after three. One, two, three, four.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will match the dots to the number.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Three dots. That goes with four!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Three dots go with the number three.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count the dots together. One, two, three. Three dots, number three!

parent_line: Can count to 4 and match numerals and dot patterns.
